name: Inner Beauty
overview: Scripture reveals that true beauty is not found in outward appearance or fleeting favor, but in the reverent fear of the Lord, which brings lasting praise (Proverbs 31:30). God’s creation is wonderfully made and intrinsically valuable, as He has fashioned each person with care and purpose (Psalms 139:14). Inner beauty shines as a reflection of God’s work and timing, bringing light and honor to those who look to Him (Psalms 34:5; Ecclesiastes 3:11). This beauty surpasses all earthly treasures, emphasizing the surpassing worth of godly character (Proverbs 3:15).
